name: Worlds-Within-Worlds Sacred Interior
best_for: one image with full universe inside subject
composition: Main subject or object becomes a container of many nested worlds; chambers, paths, tiny scenes and living ecosystems repeat at different scales.
prompt_core: Create [SUBJECT] as a worlds-within-worlds living archive. The outer silhouette must be instantly readable, but inside it are nested chambers, miniature scenes, tiny temples, rivers, forests, asuras, companions, animals, memory rooms and symbolic pathways. Every internal scene supports [STORY_SEED]. Keep the face and main gesture clear; place the complexity inside clothing, body panels, halo and base landscape. Use Kibookal sacred ecological manuscript colours and hand-inked linework.
negative: no uniform clutter, no losing the silhouette, no random tiny scenes unrelated to story_seed
render_directive: Render the requested SUBJECT / CHARACTER fully in THIS exact style. Keep the subject's identity, key features and intended action recognizable, but the medium, palette, linework, texture, composition and finish are 100% this style. ANY character, deity, creature, person, animal or object can be rendered in this style — adapt the subject INTO the style; never bend the style toward the subject.
